meaning.zh:
“溜之大吉” 或 “逃跑”。

这个短语来自于监狱里鸟笼中的鸟 “逃离笼子” 的意象，通常用来形容一个人突然离开某个地方，尤指逃避责任、避免困境或者趁机溜走。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the imagery of a bird "flying out of the coop" in a prisoner setting, often used to describe someone abruptly leaving a place, especially to dodge responsibilities, avoid a predicament, or make a quick getaway.

lines.en: When the party turned dull, Jane decided to *fly the coop*.
lines.zh: 当聚会变得无聊时，简决定溜之大吉。

lines.en: He didn't want to do any more work, so he *flew the coop* early.
lines.zh: 他不想再工作了，所以早早地溜了。

lines.en: As soon as the boss left, the workers all *flew the coop*.
lines.zh: 老板一离开，工人们就全都跑掉了。
